KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r1.claim: People hardened by conditioning may lose the ability to hear, see, and think rightly, making rational persuasion nearly impossible.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r1.anchor: Şartlanmışlık sebebiyle doğruyu dinleme, görme ve doğru düşünme kabiliyetlerini kaybetmiş kimselere laf anlatmak imkânsız gibidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r2.claim: The Prophet and those continuing his preaching should be patient and leave matters to God instead of despairing that people ignore them or that wrongdoers’ punishment is delayed.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r2.anchor: Hz. Peygamber’in ve onun tebliğ sünnetini yerine getiren ümmetin, “Neden bizi dinlemiyor ve anlamıyorlar?” veya “Bunca zulme ve sapkın inançlarda ısrara rağmen niçin bunlara hak ettikleri ceza verilmiyor?” sorularıyla bunalmamaları, aksine sabretmeleri, işi Allah’a bırakmaları gerekmektedir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r3.claim: Whether or not God shows the Prophet the polytheists’ fate, He will act as required and repay everyone; no power can withstand Him.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:43:40/r3.anchor: Allah, Hz. Peygamber’e müşriklerin âkıbetini gösterse de (nitekim bir kısmını Medine döneminde göstermiştir) göstermese de gerekeni yapacak, herkese hak ettiğini verecektir

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r4.claim: The rejecters' rebellion stems from affluence, which cannot outweigh the Hereafter; Satan's blindfold will lift too late, so the Prophet must persist in preaching the true religion attested by all prophets.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r4.anchor: The real thing which has become a source of trial for them is their affluence even though this affluence cannot tilt the scales of God’s balance

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r5.claim: The Prophet is directed to hold firmly to his preaching because the religion he calls to is the true religion, confirmed by all God's prophets.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p170/r5.anchor: The Prophet (sws) is then directed to hold fast to his preaching efforts

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p171/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p171/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p171/r4.claim: Every part of Sūrah al-Zukhruf relates deeply to its central theme, and the whole sūrah forms a harmonious unit from beginning to end.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p171/r4.anchor: each part of it is deeply related to its central theme

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p184/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p184/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p184/r4.claim: After the historical example, the passage highlights Quraysh's real rebelliousness and assures the Prophet to persist: he calls to the messengers' true path, while God may judge opponents but grants them respite by His established practice.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p184/r4.anchor: the Prophet (sws) is assured that he should adhere to his preaching

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p194/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p194/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p194/r4.claim: Despite frivolous opposition, the Prophet must adhere firmly to the call to monotheism and the revealed Book; he is rightly guided, while his opponents have no argument and will soon be defeated.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p194/r4.anchor: should strongly adhere to his call to monotheism and this Book which is revealed to him. He only is on the right path

BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r5.claim: The passage consoles the Prophet: God will punish his enemies and rejecters either during his life or after his death, through him as at Badr or without him as under Abū Bakr.
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r5.anchor: وفي الآية تسلية للنبي صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم ، بأنه تعالى ينتقم من أعدائه ومنكريه.

BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r6.claim: God leaves the Prophet between hope and fear and preserves the possibility of either outcome because knowledge of the unseen belongs to God; everyone should observe the decree and accept what God wills.
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r6.anchor: فبذلك أثبته على حد الخوف والرجاء ، ووقفه على حد التجويز لاستبداده بعلم الغيب.

BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r7.speaker: جامي
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r7.claim: Jāmī’s Persian poem cautions the heart against demanding knowledge of the outcome; both saint and prophet wander in the valley of “I do not know what will be done to me.”
BURSEVI:v8p285#3/r7.anchor:
قال المولى الجامي : 
اى دل تاكى فضولى وبو العجبى

BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r1.claim: Hold fast to the revealed Qur’an by observing its rulings, whether the promised outcome is hastened or delayed until the afterlife.
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r1.anchor: أمسك بالقرآن الذي أنزل عليك بمراعاة أحكامه سواء عجلنا لك المعهود ، أو أخرناه إلى يوم الآخرة.

BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r2.claim: The straight path is a level route without crookedness: the path of monotheism and Islam.
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r2.anchor: طريق سوى لا عوج له ، وهو طريق التوحيد ودين الإسلام.

BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r3.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r3.claim: The inward reading calls the Qur’an God’s firm rope: embody its character, follow where it leads, stop where commanded, and trust it to bring one to the divine presence.
BURSEVI:v8p286#2/r3.anchor: وفي "التأويلات النجمية" : فاعتصم بالقرآن ، فإنه حبل الله المتين

QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#1/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#1/r1.claim: The sīn reading replaces emphatic ṣād, preserving the meaning while softening the onset.
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#1/r1.anchor: preserving meaning while softening the phonetic onset

QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#2/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#2/r1.speaker: author
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#2/r1.claim: The ishmām reading blends ṣād with a zāy-like sound, changing articulation but not the path sense.
QIRAAT-ER:43:43:9#2/r1.anchor: without changing the lexical path sense

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r16.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r16.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r16.claim: After presenting the alternatives of the Prophet's death or seeing the punishment, God commands him to hold firmly to the revelation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r16.anchor: أمره بأن يستمسك بما أوحاه إليه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r17.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r17.speaker: الجمهور
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r17.claim: The majority reads أوحي in the passive voice.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r18.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r18.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r18.claim: The majority reads أوحي as passive, while some Syrian readers have a variant reading.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p375/r18.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: أوحي مبنيا للمفعول، وبعض قراء الشام:

QUSHAYRI:v3p177/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p177/r1.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p177/r1.claim: The addressee should strive without falling short, trust God without slackening, stop where commanded, and remain confident that the path is straight.
QUSHAYRI:v3p177/r1.anchor: اجتهد من غير تقصير وتوكل على الله من غير فتور ، وقف حيثما أمرت ، وثق بأنك على صراط مستقيم

ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r1.claim: The command consoles the Prophet and directs him, or his community, to persist in holding to and acting on revelation; the following clause grounds either the holding fast or its command.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r1.anchor: تسلية له صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم وأمر له عليه الصلاة والسلام أو لأمته بالدوام على التمسك بالآيات والعمل بها

ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r2.claim: The ف answers an implied condition: since one of the two matters just mentioned must occur, hold fast to what was revealed.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r2.anchor: والفاء في جواب شرط مقدر أي إذا كان أحد هذين الأمرين واقعا لا محالة فاستمسك

ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r3.claim: The statement that the Prophet is on a straight path explains either the command to hold fast or the holding fast itself.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r3.anchor: وقوله تعالى : ( إنك ) الخ للأستمساك أو للأمر به

ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r4.speaker: بعض قراء الشام
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r4.claim: Some Syrian readers pronounce أوحي with a quiescent lām.
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r4.anchor: وقرأ بعض قراء الشام ( أوحى ) بإسكان اللام

ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r5.speaker: الضحاك
ALUSI-FULL:v25p84#4/r5.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk reads أوحي in the active voice.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p215/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p215/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p215/r1.claim: The Prophet is commanded to hold firmly to the revelation, since he is on a straight path.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p215/r1.anchor: فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك إنك على صراط مستقيم

BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r5.claim: The Prophet must hold firmly to the revealed verses and laws; the path is straight and has no bend.
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r5.anchor: فاستمسك بالذي أوحى إليك } من الآيات والشرائع

BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r6.claim: Another reading makes ‘revealed’ active, with God as its subject.
BAYDAWI-FULL:43:41-45/r6.anchor: وقرىء «أوحى» على البناء للفاعل وهو الله تعالى

SULAMI:v2p234#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p234#2/r1.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p234#2/r1.claim: Although the Prophet always held fast to religion as its exemplar, God addresses him because of his exalted rank; the address teaches listeners the effort, struggle, following, and steadfastness required of them.
SULAMI:v2p234#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : أمر الله عز وجل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بالاستمساك والتمسك بالدين وهو صلى الله عليه وسلم الإمام فيه

BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r1.claim: The preceding alternatives place listeners between fear and hope, emphasize that God alone knows the unseen, and imply that punishment is inevitable and only He controls harm and benefit.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r1.anchor: أفهم السياق وإن كان شرطا أن الانتقام منهم أمر لا بد منه , وأنه لا قدرة لأحد على ضرهم ولا نفعهم إلا الله

BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r2.claim: The Prophet must diligently hold to all revelation received from the start of his prophethood, in dealing with them and in everything else.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r2.anchor: من حين نبوتك وإلى الآن في الانتقام منهم وفي غيره

BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r3.claim: The revelation is a broad, clear, straight route to the goal, so steadfast adherence leaves opponents unable to harm the Prophet.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p31/r3.anchor: موصول إلى المقصود لا يصح أصلا أن يلحقه شيء من عوج

DURR-FULL:v7p379/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p379/r7.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v7p379/r7.anchor: عن قتادة رضي الله عنه في قوله: {إنك على صراط مستقيم} قال: على الإسلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r2.claim: After easing the Prophet’s distress over their unbelief and promising victory, God commands him to remain firm in his religion and Scripture rather than lose resolve at their stubborn rejection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r2.anchor: فرع على ذلك أن أمره بالثبات على دينه وكتابه وأن لا يخور عزمه في الدعوة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r3.claim: Istimsāk means holding tightly; its added letters intensify the meaning.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r3.anchor: والاستمساك : شدة المسك ، فالسين والتاء فيه للتأكيد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r4.claim: Since the Prophet is already holding revelation, the command asks him to persist; Arabic blessings that someone remain honored illustrate this durative use, as does the prayer to be guided to the straight path in 1:6.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r4.anchor: والأمر به مستعمل في طلب الدوام ، لأن الأمر بفعل لمن هو متلبس به لا يكون لطلب الفعل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r5.claim: The revelation he must hold fast to is the Qur’an.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r6.claim: The straight path is acting on revelation; saying the Prophet is on it, rather than simply calling the path straight, portrays him as firmly guided without hesitation or fear of straying.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r6.anchor: والصراط المستقيم : هو العمل بالذي أوحي إليه ، فكأنه قيل : إنه صراط مستقيم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r7.claim: The statement that the Prophet is on a straight path confirms and explains the command to hold fast to revelation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p219/r7.anchor: وجملة { إنك على صراط مستقيم } تأييد لطلب الاستمساك بالذي أوحي إليه وتعليل له

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r1.claim: The preposition ʿalā conveys figurative elevation meaning firm establishment or mastery, as in the cited description of guidance.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r1.anchor: وحرف { على } للاستعلاء المجازي المراد به التمكن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r2.claim: The verse reassures the Messenger that he has not strayed at all from his commission and steadies believers in their faith.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r2.anchor: وهذا تثبيت للرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم وثناء عليه بأنه ما زاغ قيد أنملة عما بعثه الله به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r3.claim: This clause is counted as a sixth praise of the Qurʾān.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r3.anchor: وهذا أيضا ثناء سادس على القرآن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r4.claim: Being on a straight path is the reason for the command to hold fast and expresses the Messenger’s share of praise and support.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r8.claim: Ibn ʿĀshūr compares the verse’s ten meanings in a line’s space with Imruʾ al-Qays’s celebrated concise line, which has six; the verse adds emphasis, allusion, and verbal ornament.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v25p220/r8.anchor: قفا نبكك من ذكرى حبيبب ومنزل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p56/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p56/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p56/r7.claim: The Prophet is commanded to hold fast to everything revealed by God, both recited revelation and otherwise; the straight path means the road.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p56/r7.anchor: ثم أمر تعالى نبيه بالتمسك بما جاء من عند الله من الوحي المتلو وغيره

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r1.speaker: الجمهور
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r1.claim: Most readers use the passive form ūḥiya.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r1.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور: «أوحي» على بناء الفعل للمفعول.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r2.speaker: الضحاك
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r2.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk reads the active form awḥā, meaning that God revealed it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p57/r2.anchor: وقرأ الضحاك: «أوحى» على الفعل المبني للفاعل، أي أوحى الله.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p228#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p228#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p228#2/r5.claim: The Prophet must hold fast to the Qur’an revealed to his heart: it is truth and guides to God’s straight path, Paradise, and lasting good.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p228#2/r5.anchor: خذ بالقرآن المنزل على قلبك، فإنه هو الحق، وما يهدي إليه هو الحق

MUQATIL:43:39-43/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:43:39-43/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:43:39-43/r4.claim: Muhammad is to hold firmly to the Qur'an, for he follows a straight religion.
MUQATIL:43:39-43/r4.anchor: { فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك } من القرآن، { إنك على صراط مستقيم }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p115#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p115#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p115#4/r1.claim: The Prophet is commanded to adhere to the Quran and act by it, since he follows a straight, unbending religion.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p115#4/r1.anchor: ﴿ فاستمسك ﴾ فتمسك ﴿ بالذي أوحي إليك ﴾ وهو القرآن واعمل به ﴿ إنك على صراط مستقيم ﴾ اى على الدين الذى لا عوج له

QURTUBI-FULL:43:43-44/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:43:43-44/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:43:43-44/r1.claim: The Prophet is told to hold fast to the Quran; despite its deniers, it leads him to God, His approval, and reward.
QURTUBI-FULL:43:43-44/r1.anchor: يريد القرآن، وإن كذب به من كذب ف { إنك على صراط مستقيم } يوصلك إلى الله ورضاه وثوابه.

STUDYQURAN:43:43/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r1.claim: The injunction is to hold fast to the Quran, which keeps one on the straight path.
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r1.anchor: The injunction is to hold fast to the Quran (IK, JJ, Ṭ), which ensures that one remains upon a straight path

STUDYQURAN:43:43/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r2.claim: This contrasts the Prophet's revelation with idolaters who had no prior book to follow.
STUDYQURAN:43:43/r2.anchor: , in contrast to the idolaters, who were not given a book beforehand to which they hold fast (v. 21).

SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r2.speaker: العامة
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r2.claim: The common reading of أوحي is passive with fatḥa on yāʾ; Syrian readers sometimes use sukūn for ease.
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r2.anchor: مبنيا للمفعول مفتوح الياء، وبعض قراء الشام سكنها تخفيفا.

SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r3.speaker: الضحاك
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r3.claim: Al-Dahhak reads أوحى actively, with God as its subject.
SAMIN-DURR:43:43/r3.anchor: والضحاك " أوحى " مبنيا للفاعل وهو الله تعالى.

TABATABAI:43:41-45/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:43:41-45/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:43:41-45/r4.claim: The command to hold fast follows from all that precedes: revelation and prophethood are God's established way, the revealed Book is true, the Prophet is a clear messenger, only the Godfearing respond, and God will punish those who reject it; he is on a straight path.
TABATABAI:43:41-45/r4.anchor: فأكد عليه الأمر بعد ذلك كله أن يجد في التمسك بالكتاب الذي أوحي إليه لأنه على صراط مستقيم.

TABRISI:43:41-44/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:43:41-44/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:43:41-44/r8.claim: Holding fast to revelation means reciting the Qurʾan properly, following its commands, and avoiding its prohibitions.
TABRISI:43:41-44/r8.anchor: { فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك } من القرآن بأن تتلوه حق تلاوته وتتبع أوامره

TABRISI:43:41-44/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:43:41-44/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:43:41-44/r9.claim: The straight path is the true and correct religion, Islam.
TABRISI:43:41-44/r9.anchor: { إنك على صراط مستقيم } أي على دين حق وصواب وهو دين الإسلام

THALABI:v8p335/r10.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p335/r10.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p335/r10.claim: Muhammad must hold firmly to what was revealed to him; “it” means the Quran, and he is on a straight path.
THALABI:v8p335/r10.anchor: فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك إنك على صراط مستقيم وإنه يعني القرآن

TAB-FULL:v20p602/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r1.claim: Muhammad must hold to what the Qur’an commands and what Allah revealed; the straight, sound way is Allah’s religion, Islam.
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r1.anchor: {فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك إنك على صراط مستقيم

TAB-FULL:v20p602/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r2.claim: Qatāda identifies the straight path as Islam.
TAB-FULL:v20p602/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {فاستمسك بالذي أوحي إليك إنك على صراط مستقيم} [الزخرف: 43] «أي الإسلام»

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r1.claim: Imsāk means restraint or holding back, the opposite of release; it can also mean stinginess.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r1.anchor: الإمساك : الحبس . وضده : الإطلاق . والإمساك : أيضا : البخل

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r2.claim: The related forms distinguish leather (mask), perfume (misk), and bracelets (masaka) made of dhabal, an ivory-like material.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r2.anchor: يقال : فلان ممسك ، أي : بخيل ، والمسك : بفتح الميم وتسكين السين ، الإهاب وبكسر الميم : الطيب المعروف . وبفتح الميم والسين : الأسورة من الذبل

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r3.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r3.claim: Imsāk can mean taking a wife back or retaining her in a proper marital arrangement.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r3.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r4.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r4.claim: It can mean confining women in their homes.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r4.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r5.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r5.claim: It can mean stinginess or withholding from fear of spending.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r5.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r6.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r6.claim: It can mean keeping or preserving, as God keeps the heavens from falling or passing away.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r6.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r7.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r7.claim: It can mean withholding or preventing the release of mercy.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r7.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r8.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r8.claim: It can mean taking or holding fast, as in grasping the firm handhold.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r8.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r9.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r9.speaker: بعض المفسرين
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r9.claim: In this verse it is classified as action: holding fast to and acting upon what was revealed.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p157/r9.anchor: وذكر بعض المفسرين أن الإمساك في القرآن على سبعة أوجه

DAMGHANI:v1p434/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p434/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p434/r8.claim: Istamsaka can mean to act upon the revelation one has received.
DAMGHANI:v1p434/r8.anchor: السابع : الإمساك بمعنى العمل به . قوله تعالى فى سورة الزخرف
